mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior three months indicates an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over the prior three months indicates worsening labor market conditions, which depresses corporate profit growth expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior two months indicates robust consumer spending, which accelerates corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS rise by at least 0.5% over the prior two months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation and high interest rate regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a further increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and high interest rate regime
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.1% YoY and the regime condition (CPIAUCSL>2.5% and FEDFUNDS>3.0%) is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior three months reflects expanding manufacturing and services output, which enhances corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO rises by at least 0.3% over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1800.0 thousand units over the prior three months indicates a contracting housing sector, which dampens consumer spending and corporate capital expenditure, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls < 1800.0 (thousands of units) in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST falls below 1800.0 thousand units over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) over the prior two months indicates a severe labor market contraction, which depresses household income and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS falls by at least 0.5% and UNRATE rises by at least 0.1pp over the prior two months.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate exceeding 2.0% but decelerating), a further decline in the GDP growth rate signals an impending economic slowdown, which triggers equity sell-offs and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% and 3-month growth rate change < 0
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.0% and the 3-month growth rate change is negative.
